Genius with the intelligence of Starlight.

20002.backgroundText:
A Replica of the Peltion.
Replicas, artificial lifeforms created by Kaguya Pharmaceutical. During her time in the labs, she was referred to by her Entity Code, GA-01. She shares a mental connection with her ice wyrm, Agartha, and can control it at will. She’s not afraid to show how self-defensive and prickly she can be. However, when it comes to Narja, Gaya will always be the first to be there for her.
